correctness.rationale: Every feasible supported bistochastic matrix can be symmetrized by left translations and conjugation to a central convolution without increasing \(\|P-J\|\). The A5 character table reduces its nonconstant Fourier spectrum to four explicit scalars, and \(\max\{(1-x)/6,x/5\}\ge1/11\); the uniform 44-edge walk meets this bound with full multiplicity data. Exact 60-state integer calculations independently verify the finite-group spectral consequences; no numerical grid is used as an infinite-dimensional or continuum proof.

value.rationale: The support is the full nontrivial odd-order rotation set of the icosahedral group, a natural operation-forbidding family. Determining the exact best one-step Euclidean contraction among all potentially nonhomogeneous and nonreversible supported chains, rather than just a selected central walk, gives a sharp spectral design fact, unique symmetry-class weight proportions, and all equality eigenmodes. This is a motivated complete finite optimization and not a renamed character-table calculation.
